scope: CPU-only static implementation and tests for the missing object-level capture adapter between native M95 query observations and the frozen referent target-rank evaluator; no model forward, native score, GPU execution, queue mutation, admission, or efficacy claim

capture_contract.referent_axis: minimum native referent cost among queries whose sampled seed superpoint belongs to the object
capture_contract.objectness_axis: minimum native mask-quality cost among queries whose sampled seed superpoint belongs to the object
capture_contract.candidate_mask: all sampled superpoints whose native instance label equals the declared object ID
required_fail_closed_checks: exact target and same-class candidate coverage
nonempty native instance mask for every target and candidate
at least one native query seed for every target and candidate
query seed indices inside the exact native support
finite lower-is-better costs on both score axes
binding hashes and full code commit
rejected_without_imputation: missing candidate instance or query seed

status.stage_completed: Static object-level capture adapter and fail-closed contract tests
status.next_action: When GPU7 capacity opens, emit the native query seed indices, referent costs, mask-quality costs, instance labels, exact input hashes, and hierarchical-partition hashes for all 123 frozen expressions, pass them through this builder, then evaluate without imputation.

limitations: Unit tests validate adapter behavior, not model quality or scientific validity.
No native capture, candidate coverage, target rank, or efficacy result exists.
The fixed TRAIN cohort is diagnostic and not a held-out population sample.
Metadata same-class equality does not establish geometric confusability.
The producer must preserve query order between seed indices and both score axes.
The foreign GPU7 workload and M197-PIRS were observed only and were not touched.
